'''Hypermedia Galactic News Service''' was a [[NewsNet]]. It reported on the devastating [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] that damaged several [[City/Legends|cities]] on [[Kamori/Legends|Kamori]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] several hundred thousand individuals.<ref name="J5">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Dref Voltin]] reported on the events of the [[Battle of Sluis Van]] for the company.<ref name="HESB">{{WEGCite|book=Heir to the Empire Sourcebook|story=This is a Special Report from the Hypermedia Galactic News Service...}}</ref>
